description.value: Secret Garden is a Korean buffet and grill restaurant situated beside Lougheed Town Centre Mall in Burnaby, offering an all-you-can-eat experience of Korean cuisine in a sit-down indoor setting. The restaurant also offers takeout boxes for customers who want to bring the buffet experience home. It is a full-service dine-in establishment suited for a longer meal stop on a ride.
